result.title: AcmeCRM raises Pro plan price
result.text: Effective 10 November 2026, AcmeCRM Pro moves from $29 to $39 per seat per month, billed annually. The company cited new AI features.

result.title: AcmeCRM Pricing
result.text:
AcmeCRM Pricing
Starter: $12 per seat per month, billed annually.
Pro: $39 per seat per month, billed annually.
Enterprise: contact sales.
